entities.summary: Dante Antwane Fowler Jr. is an American professional football defensive end. He played college football for the Florida Gators and was selected third overall by the Jacksonville Jaguars in the 2015 NFL draft. Fowler missed his entire rookie season after sustaining an ACL tear. He has also played for the Los Angeles Rams, Atlanta Falcons, Dallas Cowboys, and Washington Commanders.
